title: Game of Stones
statementMd:
Sam has been teaching Jon the *Game of Stones* to sharpen his mind and help him devise a strategy to fight the white walkers. The rules of this game are quite simple:

- The game starts with $*n*$ piles of stones indexed from $1$ to $*n*$. The $*i*$-th pile contains $*s*_{*i*}$ stones.
- The players make their moves alternatively. A move is considered as removal of some number of stones from a pile. Removal of $0$ stones does not count as a move.
- The player who is unable to make a move loses.

Now Jon believes that he is ready for battle, but Sam does not think so. To prove his argument, Sam suggested that they play a modified version of the game.

In this modified version, no move can be made more than once on a pile. For example, if $4$ stones are removed from a pile, $4$ stones cannot be removed from that pile again.

Sam sets up the game and makes the first move. Jon believes that Sam is just trying to prevent him from going to battle. Jon wants to know if he can win if both play optimally.

## Input

First line consists of a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$) — the number of piles.

Each of next $*n*$ lines contains an integer $*s*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 60$) — the number of stones in $*i*$-th pile.

## Output

Print a single line containing "`YES`" (without quotes) if Jon wins, otherwise print "`NO`" (without quotes)

## Note

In the first case, Sam removes all the stones and Jon loses.

In second case, the following moves are possible by Sam: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/53b9c060b675da85f39a960b8ab29df7fe51f6e3.png)

In each of these cases, last move can be made by Jon to win the game as follows: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5089ff5bcdbeb10a07b0bf16566d6f4703e99334.png)
statementZhMd:
Sam 一直在教 Jon 玩 *Game of Stones*，以锻炼他的思维，并帮助他制定对抗白色行者的策略。这个游戏的规则非常简单：

- 游戏开始时有 $*n*$ 堆石子，编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。第 $*i*$ 堆包含 $*s*_{*i*}$ 个石子。
- 玩家轮流进行操作。一次操作被定义为从某一堆中移除一定数量的石子。移除 $0$ 个石子不算作一次操作。
- 无法进行操作的玩家输掉游戏。

现在 Jon 认为自己已经准备好迎接战斗了，但 Sam 并不这么认为。为了证明自己的观点，Sam 提议他们玩这个游戏的一个修改版本。

在这个修改版本中，每堆石子上同一种操作不能进行超过一次。例如，如果从某堆中移除了 $4$ 个石子，那么之后不能再从这一堆中移除 $4$ 个石子。

Sam 设置好了游戏并进行第一步操作。Jon 认为 Sam 只是想阻止他去战斗。Jon 想知道，如果双方都采取最优策略，他是否能够获胜。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$）——石子堆的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含一个整数 $*s*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 60$）——第 $*i*$ 堆中的石子数量。

## 输出格式

如果 Jon 获胜，输出一行包含 `YES`（不含引号）；否则输出一行包含 `NO`（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第一种情况下，Sam 移除了所有石子，Jon 输掉了游戏。

在第二种情况下，Sam 可以进行如下操作：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/53b9c060b675da85f39a960b8ab29df7fe51f6e3.png)

在这些情况下，Jon 都可以通过以下方式进行最后一步操作并赢得游戏：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5089ff5bcdbeb10a07b0bf16566d6f4703e99334.png)
